summary: The Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarship funds a small number of outstanding international students on two-year master's programmes at TU Delft, the Netherlands' largest technical university. It pays full tuition and a contribution to living costs.
covers: Full tuition fees for the first year, plus a contribution towards living expenses.
Continued funding in the second year if you earn at least 48 ECTS credits in year one.
About 16 full scholarships across TU Delft's regular MSc programmes — two per faculty.
eligibility: International applicants who are admitted, or conditionally admitted, to a two-year regular MSc programme at TU Delft.
Academic excellence — graduating in about the top 10% of your bachelor's cohort is the competitive level.
You cannot combine the award with another partial or full scholarship.
how_to_apply: Complete your MSc application at TU Delft, including your English-language certificate.
Before the deadline, submit the Van Effen scholarship application form and one reference letter.
The deadline for a start in autumn 2027 is 1 December 2026 at 23:59 CET.
Award decisions are sent at the end of March 2027.
watch_out: Your MSc application must be complete by 1 December — well before TU Delft's normal admission deadlines.
Competition is intense: far more applicants than awards. Apply for other funding too.
The living contribution is not designed to replace all income. Plan your budget for Delft's housing market before accepting.

costs: A contribution from the scholarship — not a full living allowance
The scholarship, if you earn at least 48 ECTS in your first year
You — refunded if you enrol at TU Delft
documents: Your complete TU Delft MSc application by 1 December 2026, with the €100 fee

An English certificate. TU Delft's usual MSc level is IELTS Academic 7.0 with no part below 6.5, or TOEFL iBT 100 with 22+ in each part (5 overall and 4.5+ per section on TOEFL tests taken from 20 January 2026) — check your programme
The GRE General Test, for Aerospace Engineering and some other programmes
The Van Effen scholarship application form
One reference letter — if you have two, combine them into one PDF

faq.q: Can I hold another scholarship as well?
faq.a: No. The Van Effen scholarship cannot be combined with any other partial or full scholarship.
Graduating in about the top 10% of your bachelor's programme.
TU Delft emails scholarship winners by the end of March 2027.
